        dy = a[1] - b[1]
        return (dx * dx + dy * dy) ** 0.5

    demands = get_any(["demands", "demand", "loads"])

            best_key = None
            for c in sorted(remaining):

        if len(rt) < 4:
            return rt[:]
        best = rt[:]
        best_cost = route_cost(best)
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            for i in range(len(best) - 1):
                for j in range(i + 2, len(best) + 1):
                    if i == 0 and j == len(best):
                        continue
                    cand = best[:i + 1] + best[i + 1:j][::-1] + best[j:]
                    cst = route_cost(cand)
                    if cst + 1e-12 < best_cost:
                        best = cand
                        best_cost = cst
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return best

    routes = [two_opt_route(rt) for rt in routes if rt]

    # ---------- inter-route relocate / swap ----------
    def total_cost(rts):
        return sum(route_cost(rt) for rt in rts)

    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        base_cost = total_cost(routes)

        # relocate best single customer
        best_move = None
        best_delta = 0.0
        for a in range(len(routes)):
            ra = routes[a]
            la = route_load(ra)
            for ia, c in enumerate(ra):
                dc = demands[c]
                for b in range(len(routes)):
                    if a == b:
                        continue
                    rb = routes[b]
                    lb = route_load(rb)
                    if lb + dc > capacity:
                        continue
                    # removal delta from ra
                    prev_a = depot if ia == 0 else ra[ia - 1]
                    next_a = depot if ia == len(ra) - 1 else ra[ia + 1]
                    rem = dist[prev_a][next_a] - dist[prev_a][c] - dist[c][next_a]
                    # best insertion in rb
                    best_ins = None
                    best_pos = 0
                    prev = depot
                    for p in range(len(rb) + 1):
                        nxt = depot if p == len(rb) else rb[p]
                        add = dist[prev][c] + dist[c][nxt] - dist[prev][nxt]
                        if best_ins is None or add < best_ins - 1e-12 or (abs(add - best_ins) <= 1e-12 and p < best_pos):
                            best_ins = add
                            best_pos = p
                        if p < len(rb):
                            prev = rb[p]
                    delta = rem + best_ins
                    if delta < best_delta - 1e-12 or (abs(delta - best_delta) <= 1e-12 and (a, ia, b, best_pos) < (best_move[0], best_move[1], best_move[2], best_move[3]) if best_move else True):
                        best_delta = delta
                        best_move = (a, ia, b, best_pos, c)

        if best_move is not None and best_delta < -1e-12:
            a, ia, b, pos, c = best_move
            if a < b:
                ra = routes[a]
                rb = routes[b]
            else:
                rb = routes[b]
                ra = routes[a]
            # remove and insert carefully using original indices
            c = routes[a][ia]
            routes[a].pop(ia)
            routes[b].insert(pos, c)
            routes[a] = [x for x in routes[a] if x is not None]
            routes[b] = [x for x in routes[b] if x is not None]
            routes = [rt for rt in routes if rt]
            routes = [two_opt_route(rt) for rt in routes]
            improved = True
            continue

        # swap one customer between routes if both capacities allow
        best_swap = None
        best_delta = 0.0
        for a in range(len(routes)):
            ra = routes[a]
            la = route_load(ra)
            for b in range(a + 1, len(routes)):
                rb = routes[b]
                lb = route_load(rb)
                for ia, ca in enumerate(ra):
                    da = demands[ca]
                    for ib, cb in enumerate(rb):
                        db = demands[cb]
                        if la - da + db > capacity or lb - db + da > capacity:
                            continue
                        pa = depot if ia == 0 else ra[ia - 1]
                        na = depot if ia == len(ra) - 1 else ra[ia + 1]
                        pb = depot if ib == 0 else rb[ib - 1]
                        nb = depot if ib == len(rb) - 1 else rb[ib + 1]
                        delta_a = dist[pa][cb] + dist[cb][na] - dist[pa][ca] - dist[ca][na]
                        delta_b = dist[pb][ca] + dist[ca][nb] - dist[pb][cb] - dist[cb][nb]
                        delta = delta_a + delta_b
                        if delta < best_delta - 1e-12 or (abs(delta - best_delta) <= 1e-12 and (a, ia, b, ib) < (best_swap[0], best_swap[1], best_swap[2], best_swap[3]) if best_swap else True):
                            best_delta = delta
                            best_swap = (a, ia, b, ib)
        if best_swap is not None and best_delta < -1e-12:
            a, ia, b, ib = best_swap
            routes[a][ia], routes[b][ib] = routes[b][ib], routes[a][ia]
            routes[a] = two_opt_route(routes[a])
            routes[b] = two_opt_route(routes[b])
            improved = True

        # merge empty routes removed
        routes = [rt for rt in routes if rt]

        if not improved and total_cost(routes) > base_cost + 1e-12:
            improved = False

    # ---------- final cleanup / feasibility safeguard ----------
    seen = set()
    cleaned = []
    for rt in routes:
        nr = []
        load = 0
        for c in rt:
            if c == depot:
                continue
            if c not in seen:
                if load + demands[c] <= capacity:
                    nr.append(c)
                    seen.add(c)
                    load += demands[c]
        if nr:
            cleaned.append(nr)

    missing = [c for c in customers if c not in seen]
    for c in sorted(missing):
        placed = False
        for rt in cleaned:
            if route_load(rt) + demands[c] <= capacity:
                # best insertion
                best_pos = 0
                best_add = None
                prev = depot
                for p in range(len(rt) + 1):
                    nxt = depot if p == len(rt) else rt[p]
                    add = dist[prev][c] + dist[c][nxt] - dist[prev][nxt]
                    if best_add is None or add < best_add - 1e-12 or (abs(add - best_add) <= 1e-12 and p < best_pos):
                        best_add = add
                        best_pos = p
                    if p < len(rt):
                        prev = rt[p]
                rt.insert(best_pos, c)
                placed = True
                break
        if not placed:
            cleaned.append([c])

    return cleaned
